findings.title: Concurrent builds of the same key can overwrite or fail
findings.body: Removing the lock around the whole build allows two callers to miss `GetIndex` for the same key and both reach this cache insertion. For file-backed indexes they also call `bleve.New` on the same directory, which can fail or conflict; for in-memory indexes the later insertion replaces the earlier index, potentially discarding writes made to the other instance. Serialize builds per key (while allowing different keys to build concurrently).

findings.title: Cache writes can race with `TotalDocs` map iteration
findings.body: This change makes index construction and cache insertion concurrent, but `TotalDocs` iterates `b.cache` without taking `cacheMu`. A concurrent call to `TotalDocs` while a build inserts an index can cause a Go map read/write race or fatal concurrent-map iteration/write. Protect the iteration with the same mutex.

findings.title: Initialization failure leaves the server context running
findings.body: `NewResourceServer` now runs initialization before returning. If a lifecycle hook, index build, or watcher setup fails, this returns without calling `cancel`; initialization may already have started backend resources or background goroutines, which then remain running with no server instance available to stop them. Cancel the context and clean up initialized lifecycle resources on this error path.
